ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution. Approximately 45% high-intensity pixels (white) located on lateral lobe extensions and 55% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) concentrated in the medial region and along the trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the outer thirds of both lobes. The medial region is characterized by a dark central column with high-frequency grey mottling. Three distinct black circular spots are located within the white field of the left lobe (viewer's perspective) near the lateral-anterior margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth of notch is roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge. High-frequency pixel-amplitude variations (5-20 pixels) creating a jagged profile with prominent peaks at the midpoint of each lobe's trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward convex curvature originating from the median notch and terminating at high-taper distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of three dark, circular pixel groupings on the distal-left white field. Multiple white, high-intensity calcified clusters (barnacles) are localized at the extreme apex of the right fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, unaligned dark linear disruption (approximately 40 pixels in length) oriented diagonally on the right lobe's white field. Faint vertical linear markings are visible in the lower-left dark quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization on the distal tip of the right lobe; distinct diagonal scar on the right white field.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique linear-aligned triple-spot pigmentation pattern on the distal-left fluke lobe.
